svg.font-family: Anthropic Sans, Inter, Source Sans 3, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: KMS envelope encryption: a data key encrypts the data locally, the KMS key encrypts the data key, and every KMS use is logged
svg.text: Envelope encryption: two keys, two jobs
The data key encrypts data. The KMS key encrypts the data key.
Your data (model prompts, tool payloads, session state)
encrypted by a DATA KEY (fast, local, per-item)
The data key is encrypted by your KMS key
Only the small data key ever touches KMS.
Every KMS use is logged to CloudTrail.
Why two keys: KMS calls are slow and audited. Data keys keep bulk encryption fast and local.
